executor: opencode subagent (general), fresh session per scenario
reviewer: parent (independent artifact inspection, file-hash comparison, and acceptance reruns)
method: Fixed scenarios and checklists frozen in scenarios.json before dispatch; fresh executor sessions per round; parent-side independent verification of artifacts, tests, and file hashes. Self-reported unclear points are adjudicated by the parent as skill-defect, checklist/harness-attributable, or tool-documentation before they count.
limitations: The harness exposes no canonical Task usage metadata (tool_uses/duration_ms); strict numerical convergence is not certified.

The requirements checklist is shown to the executor by the invocation contract; part of a checklist item can be satisfied from the checklist itself, so qualitative self-reports carry the instruction-side signal.
Scenario workspaces are small fixtures; they measure skill operation, not coding quality at scale.
Executors run inside the parent session's repository context; instruction-source isolation was not separately verified.
iter2 re-ran only A and C; iter3 and later re-ran the full panel.
